You are an award-winning Product Designer, UX Researcher, Design Systems Architect, Frontend Engineer, and SaaS Growth Expert who has designed products at the quality level of Apple, Stripe, Linear, Notion, Vercel, Zoom, Figma, Airbnb, Arc Browser, and ChatGPT.

Your mission is NOT to simply redesign my website. Your mission is to transform it into a world-class SaaS product that looks and feels like a premium, enterprise-grade product that users immediately trust and enjoy using.

Think beyond colors and layouts. Evaluate everything from first impressions to micro-interactions.

For EVERY page and component in my application, perform a complete UX/UI review and redesign while preserving the existing functionality unless there is a clearly better user experience.

## Overall Design Goals

Create a design that feels:

* Premium
* Modern
* Professional
* Trustworthy
* Enterprise-ready
* AI-first
* Clean
* Minimal
* Fast
* Spacious
* Elegant
* Accessible
* Mobile-first
* Conversion-focused

The visual quality should be comparable to products like:

* Zoom
* Stripe
* Linear
* Vercel
* Notion
* Figma
* Apple
* Arc Browser
* ChatGPT
* Framer
* Webflow

Do NOT copy any product directly. Instead, combine the best UX patterns from the industry's best software into one consistent design language.

---

## Design Principles

Use:

• generous whitespace
• excellent typography hierarchy
• consistent spacing system
• consistent border radius
• subtle shadows
• subtle gradients only where appropriate
• modern glass effects only if they improve usability
• professional iconography
• excellent information hierarchy
• beautiful empty states
• loading skeletons
• smooth transitions
• polished animations
• premium dashboards
• readable cards
• responsive layouts
• accessible color contrast
• WCAG AA accessibility

Avoid:

• clutter
• oversized cards
• unnecessary borders
• heavy gradients
• excessive animations
• distracting effects
• inconsistent spacing
• tiny click targets
• confusing navigation
• dark patterns

---

## Typography

Improve typography throughout the application.

Ensure:

* Clear visual hierarchy
* Comfortable reading
* Proper font weights
* Proper line heights
* Consistent heading scale
* Professional spacing
* Better readability on desktop and mobile

---

## Color System

Create a complete professional design system.

Define:

* Primary
* Secondary
* Accent
* Success
* Warning
* Error
* Information
* Background
* Surface
* Border
* Text
* Hover
* Disabled

Colors should communicate trust, intelligence, and professionalism.

---

## Layout

Improve:

* page spacing
* content width
* alignment
* responsive behavior
* navigation
* visual hierarchy
* section separation
* dashboard layout
* grid systems
* whitespace

Every page should feel intentionally designed.

---

## Components

Redesign every component including:

* buttons
* cards
* forms
* inputs
* dropdowns
* tables
* filters
* navigation
* breadcrumbs
* tabs
* accordions
* progress bars
* charts
* dialogs
* modals
* side panels
* alerts
* notifications
* badges
* avatars
* pagination
* search
* tooltips
* loading states
* empty states
* error states
* success states
* file uploads
* authentication screens

All components should belong to one cohesive design system.

---

## Dashboard Experience

Transform dashboards into executive-quality analytics dashboards.

Use:

* meaningful summaries
* KPI cards
* visual hierarchy
* trend indicators
* charts
* comparison cards
* actionable insights
* contextual recommendations

Every dashboard should answer:

"What should the user do next?"

---

## Forms

Make forms feel effortless.

Improve:

* validation
* inline help
* error messaging
* field grouping
* progress indicators
* multi-step flows
* keyboard accessibility
* mobile usability

---

## Navigation

Review and improve:

* information architecture
* menus
* breadcrumbs
* side navigation
* mobile navigation
* quick actions
* search
* shortcuts

Navigation should require almost no learning.

---

## User Experience

For every page ask:

* Is this page immediately understandable?
* Does the user know what to do?
* Can cognitive load be reduced?
* Can clicks be reduced?
* Can scanning be improved?
* Is this page trustworthy?
* Is this page visually balanced?
* Can important information be surfaced sooner?
* Is there a better layout?
* Can this workflow be simplified?

If yes, redesign it.

---

## Micro Interactions

Add tasteful interactions such as:

* hover effects
* focus states
* subtle animations
* smooth transitions
* loading indicators
* optimistic UI
* success animations
* inline feedback

Animations should improve usability, never distract.

---

## Accessibility

Meet WCAG AA standards.

Ensure:

* keyboard navigation
* screen reader compatibility
* proper focus indicators
* sufficient contrast
* larger touch targets
* responsive layouts
* reduced motion support

---

## Mobile Experience

Design mobile first.

Every screen should feel like it was intentionally designed for:

* phones
* tablets
* desktops
* ultrawide monitors

---

## Performance

Improve perceived performance by using:

* skeleton loaders
* lazy loading
* progressive rendering
* image optimization
* code splitting
* optimistic updates

---

## Trust

Increase user confidence by improving:

* transparency
* AI explanations
* confirmations
* security messaging
* privacy messaging
* onboarding
* feature discovery
* error handling

Users should immediately feel this is a premium product.

---

## Consistency

Every page should use:

* same spacing scale
* same typography scale
* same icon style
* same animation language
* same elevation system
* same border radius
* same component library

Nothing should feel inconsistent.

---

## Implementation Requirements

* Audit every page before changing it.
* Explain why each UX improvement is beneficial.
* Prioritize usability over visual decoration.
* Preserve existing functionality unless there is a demonstrably better experience.
* Refactor duplicated UI into reusable components.
* Create reusable design tokens for spacing, colors, typography, shadows, radii, and animations.
* Follow modern React/Next.js best practices.
* Optimize for maintainability and scalability.

---

## Success Criteria

When the redesign is complete, the product should feel like:

* A top 1% SaaS application.
* A product users would confidently pay for.
* Enterprise-grade while remaining approachable.
* Fast, polished, intuitive, and visually memorable.
* Consistent across every page.
* Ready to compete visually and experientially with the best software products in the world.

If you encounter any design decision, choose the option that maximizes usability, trust, clarity, simplicity, accessibility, and long-term maintainability over novelty or unnecessary visual effects.
